headline: Microsoft has made major upgrades to Copilot Notebooks to compete with Google's NotebookLM, Neowin reports.
score_reason: Lowered from 5: only the headline could be checked, from a single outlet, so the size and timing of the upgrades are unverified.
importance_line: People who use AI to study or organise their documents are affected first, then Microsoft and Google as rivals in this space, but what the upgrades include, who gets them and when are not yet known.
summary: Neowin reports that Microsoft has made major upgrades to Copilot Notebooks, in what it presents as a move against NotebookLM, Google's AI research and note-taking tool.
notes: Neowin article blocked (HTTP 403); no other outlet found. Published 12 Oct 2026 04:20 UTC per Google News; the event date is not known.
